raw_text: Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant cyber intrusion is concerning but context matters. The Lazarus Group malware was on the administrative network only. OT systems are air-gapped. However, this is the second known cyber incident at Kudankulam. India's nuclear cyber security posture clearly needs improvement. DAE security audit is a good step but should have happened proactively.
clean_text: Kudankulam cyber intrusion is second known incident at the plant. Lazarus malware on admin network only, OT air-gapped. DAE audit welcomed but should have been proactive.
